original_issue.objective: Discover and independently verify previously unknown usable ESP32-C3 ROM/SoC functions or capabilities; never conflate unknown boundary and usable novel API

mvp.description: Independently extract byte-evidenced unknown function entry candidates from all three C3 ROM images without leaked function labels/boundaries, measure exact-entry recovery on a sealed oracle against byte-only baselines and retain graded unknown/error status; do not claim novel API without separate proof.

acceptance_criteria.criteria: Pinned ELF ROM bytes and evaluator-only function oracle are logically separated with mutation rejection and alias dedup.
Byte-only RV32I/C scan and bounded rooted CFG produce traceable call/link candidates, basic block destinations distinguished, unknown indirect/data remains unknown.
Sealed evaluator measures EXACT start PC for 3 ROM revisions without oracle access to candidate generation; raw baseline, rooted baseline and independent negative tests; no false precision.
New indirect edges require machine-byte def-use witnesses and crossrevision normalization; otherwise UNKNOWN.
Novel/callable/hardware capability confirmed only through independent dated prior art, ABI and revision-matched hardware evidence; if none verified, 0.
DAG/AC task JSON pinned in GitHub; each claimed passed task has GitHub Actions logs and reproducible verdict.

constraints: GitHub and CI allowed; no unapproved real silicon RF writes
No using ELF names or function extents in generator
3 pinned Espressif ROM revisions and exact SHA
No answer leakage or fabricated silicon result
timeboxed CI, 2 repair attempts per stage
only read actual CI logs to claim PASS
